def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log-probability matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.issubdtype(type(tau_filter), np.floating) and not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # 1. Normalize decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    # t = j - i, first future token uses t=0
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        raise ValueError("All raw weights are zero (horizon may be too large)")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Helper to compute weighted loss for a matrix
    def weighted_loss(logp: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.dot(logp, normalized_weights)  # shape (n_candidates,)

    # 2. Compute weighted future-token loss (T02)
    L_with = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # 3. Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # 4. Filtering threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    # 5. Preserve order (T05) - already done by array order
    return keep, margin
